questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the smallest planet in the solar system (excluding dwarf planets)?
A. Mars
B. Mercury
C. Venus
Answer: B.
questions.en: What is the smallest planet in the Solar System (excluding dwarf planets)?
questions.de: Welches ist der kleinste Planet im Sonnensystem (Zwergplaneten ausgenommen)?

timeline.labelEn: IAU reclassifies Pluto as a dwarf planet, leaving Mercury the smallest planet
timeline.labelDe: Die IAU stuft Pluto zum Zwergplaneten herab; Merkur wird damit zum kleinsten Planeten

questions.cardText:
[Economics] How does quantitative easing (QE) stimulate the economy?
A. By directly lowering the overnight federal fund rate
B. By selling bonds
C. By purchasing securities
Answer: C. By purchasing financial assets, central banks can inject money directly into the financial system, lowering interest rates and encouraging lending and investment. QE can be used when traditional tools become ineffective. It was notably used during the 2008 financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic to support economic recovery and prevent deflation.
questions.en: In quantitative easing (QE), what does a central bank buy in large amounts to inject money into the financial system and stimulate the economy?
questions.de: Was kauft eine Zentralbank bei der quantitativen Lockerung (QE) in großem Umfang, um Geld in das Finanzsystem zu pumpen und die Wirtschaft anzukurbeln?

timeline.labelEn: The Bank of Japan introduces the first quantitative easing programme
timeline.labelDe: Die Bank of Japan führt das erste Programm der quantitativen Lockerung ein
